## Lesson 3 — Separate authoring and finite-pi views {#lesson-ch7-diagrams}

Current source cells use full explicit layouts bound to fresh preparation. Stored figures and Notebook outputs retain their original execution identities; this source-only update does not regenerate them.

### Review the declared body

```{python}
#| id: ch7-render-authoring
from examples.engineer.diagram_layouts import engineer_layout

authoring_preparation = plan.prepare_schematic(
    CircuitDiagramSpec(
        representation="authoring", theme=Theme.AUTO,
        show_parameter_values=True,
    )
)
authoring_layout = engineer_layout(authoring_preparation, "ordered_mtl")
authoring = plan.render_schematic(
    CircuitDiagramSpec(
        layout=authoring_layout, representation="authoring", theme=Theme.AUTO,
        show_parameter_values=True,
    )
)
display(authoring.show())
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

{{< include ../figures/07-n2-authoring.md >}}

:::

```{python}
#| id: ch7-show-authoring-audit
if authoring is not None:
    authoring.audit.show()
```

### Request the compiled presentation independently

```{python}
#| id: ch7-render-compiled
compiled = None
try:
    compiled = plan.render_schematic(
        CircuitDiagramSpec(
            representation="compiled",
            theme=Theme.AUTO,
            show_parameter_values=True,
        )
    )
except SCNSimValidationError as error:
    if error.stage != "schematic_layout":
        raise
    display({"compiled layout unavailable": str(error), "stage": error.stage})
if compiled is not None:
    display(compiled.show())
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

{{< include ../figures/07-n2-compiled.md >}}

:::

When available, the compiled diagram expands eight finite pi sections and its
audit retains conductor order, full matrices, and exact-zero evidence. A typed
layout failure does not change the authored Plan or numerical model.
